scope: Independent anonymous pull and disposable no-radio verification of a GHCR build candidate, not physical equivalence or final-tag publication.
verification: Anonymous pull of exact index digest succeeded; labels and architecture verified.

All 54 frozen livolod context files, wrapper bytes and embedded release metadata matched the reviewed frozen context; helper CLIs, disabled unconfigured wrapper, empty public firmware catalog and pip check passed.
Disposable no-radio startup used private data/network, resolved service alias, served authenticated API, correctly reported offline radio and disabled controls, and ran daemon as UID 10001.
Disposable install/recreation harness passed native authenticated API, WebSocket, persistence, SQLite integrity, UID, trusted ingress/Origin and persistent local catalog checks; no radio was mounted.
Both source archive SHA256SUMS manifests verified; flasher source archive matches required public source hash. Debian package inventory records 97 packages, all with standard copyright files.

inventory.notice: Metadata omissions do not by themselves establish missing legal notices or source; separate notice review applies.

build_comparison: Published config/image ID differs from the physically tested local image. Dependency names, versions, source hashes and license metadata matched; built wheel SHA256 differs for the local daemon and Nordic crcmod, nrfutil and pyspinel. Same source is not a byte-identical runtime or physical-equivalence claim.

attestations.sbom: Nonempty SPDX-2.3 document; 207 packages and 3397 files.
attestations.provenance: Nonempty SLSA output includes frozen revision and pinned Python image; pinned BuildKit digest was not found in its text. Presence and inspection are not independent signature verification.

limits: No physical radio, existing HA data or live daemon was touched.
Final experimental tag promotion and publicly downloadable supporting assets require separate verification.
Changed-address DNS recovery, HA OS/Supervisor and other radio boards are not qualified.
